intro: Create persistent counters without editing C#. Start with one counter, then add only the controls and event awards you need.

sections.title: 1. Start here
sections.description: Name the first counter and choose the value Reset returns to.

sections.title: 2. Create distinct counter commands
sections.description: Set up every counter here. Each line creates one independent broadcaster/moderator command through the Bridge, with no Streamer.bot action or Command object required.
sections.notice: Add death=deaths|Deaths and win=wins|Wins. Then use !death or !win to add one; !death -1; !death reset; !win set 5; !win show; or !win rename Match Wins. The safe !streamcounter deaths +1 form remains available too.

sections.title: 3. Optional automatic counting
sections.description: Zero means ignored. Non-zero awards apply only to genuine normalized events.

sections.title: 4. Overlay layout
sections.description: Add the overlay URL shown above to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop. Use a 512 x 512 transparent PNG or WebP; the overlay preserves its 1:1 box and never stretches the image.

sections.title: 5. Overlay style
sections.description: Choose readable typography, colors, border, and motion. Reduced-motion browser settings disable animation automatically.

sections.title: 6. Optional manual controls
sections.description: Wizard-created counter commands need no Streamer.bot import. The separate import is only for creator hotkeys, Stream Deck buttons, or non-chat triggers.
sections.notice: Do not duplicate actions for chat commands. Configure the distinct commands above and let the Bridge route them. Use the imported actions only when a physical button or another trusted Streamer.bot trigger is genuinely needed.
